excerpt: Calculate net rental yield for a Sharjah apartment using collected rent, owner expenses and the complete acquisition cost.
introduction:
Rental yield compares annual income with the capital invested in a property. For a useful Sharjah apartment calculation, start with evidence of rent, allow for vacancy and deduct owner-paid costs before dividing by the full acquisition cost. The result is an estimate, not a guaranteed return.

This guide uses sample figures to explain the arithmetic. Replace them with the actual unit's purchase quote, comparable leases and current building charges.
takeaways: Net operating income is expected rent less vacancy and owner-paid operating costs.
Divide by the full acquisition cost and use the same cost categories for every property.
Mortgage payments, tax, capital gains and selling costs require separate analysis.

sections.heading: What is the formula?
sections.body:
Estimate annual contractual rent using recent signed leases for comparable apartments. Subtract an allowance for vacancy or uncollected rent, then deduct the owner's service charges, management, repairs, insurance and other operating costs. The result is net operating income.

Divide net operating income by the purchase price plus acquisition and initial setup costs, then multiply by 100. Make the denominator explicit so that comparisons do not mix a purchase price for one property with a full cost for another.

Gross yield, often annual rent divided by the purchase price, can be a quick screen but leaves out vacancy and owner costs. It is not the cash the landlord will necessarily receive.

sections.heading: Calculate the example
sections.body:
Assume a purchase price of AED 700,000 and AED 35,000 of acquisition and setup costs, for AED 735,000 total capital. Assume AED 60,000 rent, AED 5,000 vacancy, AED 10,000 service charges, AED 3,000 management, AED 4,000 repairs and AED 1,000 insurance.

Net operating income is AED 60,000 minus AED 23,000, or AED 37,000. Divide AED 37,000 by AED 735,000 and multiply by 100: approximately 5.03%. The chart shows the components of this single calculation. These example amounts show how rent and owner costs combine in a yield calculation.

The result excludes mortgage payments, tax, changes in property value and the cost of selling. A full investment decision needs those additional cash flows and a reserve.

sections.heading: Use relevant lease evidence
sections.body:
Ask for recent signed leases in the same building where available, with similar size, floor, condition, parking, furnishing and included services. Record the date and any rent-free period. An advertised rent is not proof of the amount agreed or collected.

Allow for time between tenants and possible repairs before reletting. Test a longer vacancy and a lower rent rather than assuming the apartment is occupied every day. If the unit is off-plan, allow for completion, handover and setup before rent can begin.

The [Aljada and Al Mamsha area guide](/journal/aljada-vs-al-mamsha-apartment-buying-comparison) explains why building and phase matter. An area-wide average cannot establish the rent for one unit.

sections.heading: Check the costs and ownership right
sections.body:
Request the unit's current service-charge statement, payment schedule and management contact. Add the owner's management, insurance, repairs and any utilities paid while vacant. Clarify which costs a tenant pays under the lease and avoid counting the same amount twice.

Ask Sharjah's registration department for the current buyer's right and transaction quote for the exact property. The [Sharjah purchase cost guide](/journal/total-cost-of-buying-an-apartment-in-sharjah) covers the categories to include; the [ownership guide](/journal/how-to-check-foreign-ownership-eligibility-in-sharjah) explains the eligibility check.

Sharjah Municipality's [residential tenancy contract template](https://portal.shjmun.gov.ae/en/eservices/Attachements/Residential-Tenancy-Contract-Template.pdf) describes lease attestation and obligations. Confirm the current procedure and costs for the agreement.

sections.heading: Separate financing and the exit
sections.body:
For a mortgage, prepare a second schedule showing rent collected, operating expenses, loan payments and outstanding principal. Interest and principal have different effects, and net operating yield is not the same as cash flow after the bank. Ask for current lender terms and test a change in rate or income.

Estimate the eventual sale proceeds using a range of prices, less selling costs and the remaining loan. A one-year yield does not include capital gains or losses and does not guarantee liquidity. Seek recent comparable completed sales where available.

The [Sharjah market outlook](/journal/sharjah-property-market-outlook) uses department-reported aggregate transactions as context, not a yield for an individual apartment.

sections.heading: Stress-test the assumptions
sections.body:
Recalculate with a longer vacancy, lower rent and an unexpected repair. Ask whether the property remains affordable if income falls while service charges or loan payments continue. Keep a cash reserve for those periods.

Record the source and date of each input. A current building statement and a signed comparable lease provide a stronger basis than a headline advertised return. If an amount is unknown, show a range and update it when a written quote arrives.

sections.heading: Use a consistent comparison period
sections.body:
Calculate each property's income and costs over the same twelve months. If one unit is furnished, include the cost of furnishing or replacement; if another requires work before a tenant can move in, account for that expense and the time involved. Record whether utilities and parking are included in rent.

Ask which management services are covered by a quote and whether applicable tax is included. Keep the original documents with the worksheet so a change in charge, lease or acquisition cost can be reflected without mixing old and new assumptions. A yield should show the inputs on which it depends.

sections.heading: Apply the calculation to a current unit
sections.body:
Browse the [Aliyas Sharjah project collection](/projects?emirate=Sharjah) and [contact Aliyas](/contact) with your budget, nationality and intended tenant. Ask which specific units are currently available and request their plans, prices and charges.

Verify ownership, current official costs and comparable lease evidence before making an investment decision.
